# T0.9 — fast refresh vs full profile over chains of rewrites

## The question

Over successive rewrites, does a fast refresh reach the conclusions a full re-profile reaches — and where not, is the divergence the dangerous kind (a suggestion the measured profile does not support)?

## Result in one paragraph

23 Sep (after D29): 11 of 18 comparisons identical, 7 produce a suggestion the measured profile does not support (18 Sep: 8 / 8 / 2 lost).
